entities.name: Pürevdorjiin Serdamba
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Pürevdorjiin Serdamba is a retired Mongolian amateur boxer. He won a silver medal at the 2008 Olympics in the junior flyweight division. He became the first Mongolian to win a gold medal at the World Amateur Boxing Championships in 2009.
